chunks: Hanan ibn Sadeer narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
It is sufficient for you to take the pebbles for the Jamarat from anywhere within the boundaries of the Haram, except from the Sacred Mosque and Masjid al-Khayf.

key_terms.حَصَى: small pebbles used for ritual stoning
key_terms.ٱلْجِمَارِ: the Jamarat, the stoning sites in hajj rites

ai.seo_question: From where may the pebbles for the Jamarat be taken during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding where pebbles for the Jamarat may be collected during hajj. It states that they may be taken from anywhere within the Haram, but excludes al-Masjid al-Haram and Masjid al-Khayf from permissible collection.
